annotations.title: What a basket cost on an earlier date

description:
How the cost of the same basket changed between two dates, at the store it was bought from: each product's price on both dates, whether it was on promotion, the basket total on each date, and the products that moved it. BasketWatch has recorded every product's price every night since May 2026 (Lidl's since 17 October 2026). Up to 100 lines per call; each line takes name, sku (the retailer's printed item number, with the line's words in name), barcode, store and quantity.

change_pct is the change in what the basket cost (promotions included); shelf_change_pct is regular prices only, so the gap between the two is promotions starting or ending, not price rises. biggest_rises and biggest_falls list the lines that moved most; pack_changed marks a product whose pack size changed, confirmed over three days of records (a smaller pack at the same price is a hidden rise). Lines in not_compared were not found, or not sold on one of the dates.

Each product compared costs one credit.

count.description: How many items in the pack, when not in name, e.g. 12 for a dozen eggs, 6 for a six pack. Not how many packs were bought: that is quantity

name.description: Brand, product and size in plain words, e.g. 'avonmore fresh milk 2l', '12 eggs', 'dozen eggs'

paid.description: The line total printed on the receipt, in euro

size.description: The pack size wanted, when not in name, e.g. '2L', '500g': chooses that size at each store

sku.description: The retailer's own item number printed on the receipt line, when there is one

store.description: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl; defaults to the basket's store

items.description: The lines, up to 100, e.g. [{'name': 'avonmore fresh milk 2l', 'quantity': 2}, {'name': 'brennans wholemeal bread'}]; for a receipt add sku and paid: {'sku': '100685955', 'name': 'dunnes baked beans', 'quantity': 2, 'paid': 1.30}.

store.description: The shop the receipt is from (aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl), used for any line that names none. Leave it out for a shopping list.

to_date.description: The later date, YYYY-MM-DD. Left out: today.
